tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: The README.md provides a comprehensive overview of the HDY Motion Control Library, a pure C99 motion-control library for hydraulic injection-molding machines. It explains the design boundary that separates the process layer (valve logic, sequencing) from the motion control layer (velocity/pressure planning, pump speed conversion), and guides you through building, testing, and deploying the library.

tour.title: Core API Contract
tour.description: The motion_control.h header defines the PLCopen-style HYD_MotionControlFB function block interface. This is the core API that the process layer calls to execute multi-segment recipes with position, speed-ramp, or pressure-closed-loop modes. It includes the full lifecycle semantics (Init -> LoadRecipe -> StartSegment -> Execute -> NextSegment/Done) and output structures for state, pump speed, diagnostics, and segment completion flags.
tour.languageLesson: PLCopen function blocks follow a lifecycle pattern: Init for setup, Execute for the periodic scan cycle, and dedicated functions like StartSegment/NextSegment for segment transitions. The EN/ENO gate is handled at the IEC interface layer, not in the core implementation.

tour.title: Type System Foundation
tour.description: common_types.h contains all shared data structures, enums, and type definitions used throughout the codebase. This includes HYD_MotionSegment for recipe parameters, HYD_AXISMOTION for axis feedback, HYD_STATE for execution states, and various control mode enums. Understanding these types is essential because they define the vocabulary shared between the planner, controller, and IEC interface layers.
tour.languageLesson: In C, forward declarations of structs are used extensively when multiple files depend on each other. Include guards (#ifndef ... #endif) prevent multiple inclusion errors, which is critical in large header files like common_types.h.

tour.title: Motion Planning Core
tour.description: motion_planner.c implements velocity and flow reference calculation using time-based velocity ramps with braking protection. It computes the planned velocity and flow based on the segment's target parameters, max acceleration, and velocity limits. segment_completion.c acts as the single source of truth for evaluating when a segment should end, checking position, time, pressure, flow, or manual completion conditions.

tour.title: Pressure Control Implementation
tour.description: pressure_controller.c provides P/PI/PID control strategies for closed-loop pressure mode, with anti-windup, bumpless tracking, and derivative-rate filtering. This module smooths the target pressure using ramp_controller.c, then applies the selected control algorithm to minimize error between measured and target pressure. The controller integrates seamlessly with the planner's flow reference for feedforward control.
tour.languageLesson: PID control with anti-windup prevents the integral term from accumulating unbounded error when the control signal saturates. Bumpless tracking ensures smooth transitions between control modes without sudden pressure spikes.

tour.title: Execution Example
tour.description: The tests/main.c file demonstrates a complete multi-segment recipe execution cycle. It shows how to initialize the function block, load a 5-segment recipe with different control modes (speed-ramp and pressure-closed-loop), execute it in a simulation loop, and handle segment completion events. This is the best entry point to understand the runtime behavior and diagnostic output format.

tour.title: Physics Simulation Layer
tour.description: The simulation layer (src/sim/hydro_sim.c + hydro_sim_fb.c) provides a physics kernel for development and testing. hydro_sim_fb.c is the PLC adapter layer that translates create/move/read commands into the simulator's internal representation, while hydro_sim.c implements the hydraulic physics model including single-pump scheduling, CLAMP/INJECT cylinder models, and fault injection for testing.
tour.languageLesson: The simulator uses a shared HydraulicSimEnv structure that is stepped exactly once per __HydSimulator_framework_Publish() call. This ensures that multiple function blocks in the same PLC scan cycle only advance physics by one tick, matching real PLC behavior.

tour.title: IEC61131-3 Interface Adapter
tour.description: motion_interface.c implements the IEC61131-3 PLCopen function block interface. It provides a pool of up to 20 function block instances, handles command arbitration between multiple instances competing for the same axis, and exposes 6 standard PLCopen FBs (MoveProfile, MoveAbsolute, MoveVelocity, PressureHandle, Stop, Reset). This layer translates between the process layer's IEC-style calls and the core library's internal execution flow.
tour.languageLesson: IEC61131-3 function blocks follow a specific lifecycle: Init for setup, then Execute() called in each PLC scan cycle. The EN (enable) gate is checked at this interface layer before invoking the core execution, and ENO (enable output) is propagated back to the PLC program.

tour.title: Diagnostic System
tour.description: The diagnostics module (diagnostics.c) manages the complete diagnostic system including code-to-string conversion, severity classification (NONE/WARNING/FAULT), and snapshot history for troubleshooting. It integrates with state_reporter.c to track execution events and provides real-time diagnostic output (DIAGNOSTIC struct) with recovery suggestions and protection actions (DERATE/STOP). The HMI diagnosis table maps these codes to user-friendly Chinese text.

tour.title: Build Configuration
tour.description: CMakeLists.txt defines the build system for both HydroMotionLib (core library without simulation) and HydroSimLib (simulation library). It includes all source files, sets up static library targets, and integrates with CTest for test execution. The coverage.sh script uses gcovr to generate test coverage reports, while deploy_embedded_prod.sh creates production builds that exclude the simulation code for smaller footprint deployment.
tour.languageLesson: CMake's file(GLOB_RECURSE ...) directive automatically discovers new source files, which is why cmake --preset unixgcc needs to be re-run when adding new src/*.c files. This keeps the build configuration declarative and maintainable.

tour.title: Testing Infrastructure
tour.description: The testing layer includes unit tests for every core module (motion_planner, pressure_controller, segment_completion, etc.) plus integration tests like test_scenario_matrix that cover typical injection-molding scenarios. The benchmark_performance.c program measures execution time for each module, helping validate real-time feasibility. This comprehensive test suite ensures the library works correctly across different operating modes and edge cases.
